It features a custom matrix for fixing royalty ranges and automatically fetches default macroeconomic data (depreciation, bank rates) if specific inputs are missing, outputting a comprehensive PDF valuation report.
applications:
• Technology Transfer Offices (TTOs) negotiating licensing deals with startups

• Corporate R&D strategic planning and technology pricing

• Financial securitization, IP taxation, and venture capital auditing

• Legal settlements for patent infringement lawsuits
startup_potential: Low (Functions as an institutional administrative tool for internal tech-transfer rather than a consumer spin-off)
keywords: DSS, technology valuation, IP valuation, intellectual property, royalty rate, commercialization, tech transfer, CWRDM
